_note: Fixed facts the report states in words. Each carries the file or PR it was read from. Measured numbers never live here.

device.value: Raspberry Pi 5, 4 cores, 4 GB, Zynthian vangelis-2610.1-2, Debian 13 trixie arm64, kernel 6.18

upstream_state.value: All changes are pull requests inside the FreeMixer forks. None is open on the zynthian organisation yet.
upstream_state.source: briefs 2026-10-26-zynthian-ui-engine and zynthian-sys-openmixer: open nothing on the upstream organisation

prs.role: OpenMixer apt repository and install recipe
plugin-hostd as the mod-host of MOD-UI, one switch
MOD GUIs generated from the plugin descriptions
OpenMixer in the default install and the update path
PH engine for LV2 and CLAP plugins
PH as default engine, snapshot converter, menus from qualification

change.text: An apt repository for OpenMixer and a recipe that installs plugin-hostd, omx-clap-host, omx-plugins and omx-panel
ZYNTHIAN_MODHOST_BACKEND picks what answers MOD-UI on port 5555: jack_load, or plugin-hostd
A plugin that ships no MOD GUI gets one made by omx-panel modgui from its descriptor
OpenMixer is installed by default on new images and by update_zynthian_sys.sh and update_system_image.sh
A new engine, PH, runs LV2 and CLAP plugins in one plugin-hostd daemon per Zynthian, on port 5570, and declares the members of a Zynthian chain to the daemon as a chain
plugin-hostd is the default engine, and the plugin menus are built from plugin-qualify records

user.text: The plugin controller pages come from omx-panel's layout of the plugin descriptor, eight controls to a page
Each plugin entry carries a tag such as 'live, 1.2 ms, RT'; live means real-time safe with a measured latency of at most ZYNTHIAN_PLUGIN_LIVE_MS (5) at the worst measured rate
Plugins that are pinned refused, or that crashed or hung during qualification, are hidden; ZYNTHIAN_PLUGIN_SHOW_HIDDEN=1 lists them last, greyed, with the reason

revert.text: sbin/set_modhost_backend.sh jack_load|plugin-hostd switches the mod-host backend and restarts mod-ui
ZYNTHIAN_PLUGIN_ENGINE=jalv switches the plugin menus back to jalv; the jalv entries stay in the engine list, so a snapshot that holds a JV processor loads as saved
tools/convert_snapshots_to_ph.py is run once by hand and writes foo.ph.zss beside foo.zss, never overwriting
Each default step runs once and is recorded in /zynthian/config/openmixer-defaults; the recipe starts and restarts nothing
MOD-UI chains keep the MD engine and MIDI tools stay with jalv

try.text: curl -fsSLO https://www.openmixer.org/deb/openmixer-release.deb, then sudo apt install ./openmixer-release.deb and sudo apt install plugin-hostd omx-clap-host omx-clap-scan omx-panel
Check out the zynthian-ui branch in /zynthian/zynthian-ui and restart zynthian; enable one LV2 effect in webconf so its (PH) entry shows up
On an existing Zynthian run scripts/update_zynthian_sys.sh from the zynthian-sys branch and read the 'OpenMixer defaults' report; apply with sbin/set_modhost_backend.sh plugin-hostd or reboot
For a new image run setup_zynthian.sh, then scripts/omx_prequalify_image.sh natively on arm64 before taking the image; the package's timer runs the qualification sync two minutes after every boot
